columns.name: max_delivery_km
columns.comment: Optional per-vendor delivery radius cap in km. NULL = no restriction (covers all compounds by distance). Ignored for a restaurant if it has any explicit rows in vendor_coverage.

columns.name: cover_image_url
columns.comment: Chosen cover photo for the home card. Null falls back to the best-ranked photographed menu item.

columns.name: closed_until
columns.comment: Temporary close set by the vendor. Expires by itself; NULL or in the past means not closed.

columns.name: display_order
columns.comment: Explicit position in the customer list. NULL = unranked. Lower shows first. A closed vendor still sinks below every open one.

columns.name: featured
columns.comment: Lifted above unranked vendors without a specific position. Ordering only -- nothing is shown to the customer.

columns.name: is_shelf_label
columns.comment: True = a section heading: browsable, never orderable, never searchable. False = a real product.

columns.name: prescription_path
columns.comment: Object name in the private `prescriptions` storage bucket. Read access is granted only to an admin or to the vendor that owns this order -- see the storage policies. Never build a public URL from this.

columns.name: is_adjustment
columns.comment: True for admin price adjustments rather than ordered products. menu_item_id is null on these.

columns.name: service_fee_waived
columns.comment: Service fee deliberately not charged on this adjustment. Records the gift so it survives review.

columns.name: link_url
columns.check: link_url IS NULL OR link_url ~ '^/[A-Za-z0-9/_?=&%.:-]*$'::text OR link_url ~ '^https?://[^\s]+$'::text
